mapper.insert: INSERT INTO orders ( order_id, portfolio_id, instrument_id, side, quantity, price, status, idempotency_key, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( (('x' || substr(md5(#{orderId}), 1, 16))::bit(64)::bigint & 9223372036854775807), (SELECT p.portfolio_id FROM portfolio p WHERE p.account_id = #{accountId}), (SELECT i.instrument_id FROM instruments i WHERE i.ticker = #{symbol}), #{side}, #{quantity}, #{price}, #{status}, #{idempotencyKey}, #{createdOn}, #{updatedOn} )
mapper.update: UPDATE orders SET status = #{status}, updated_at = #{updatedOn} WHERE order_id = (('x' || substr(md5(#{orderId}), 1, 16))::bit(64)::bigint & 9223372036854775807)
mapper.select: SELECT #{orderId} AS orderId, o.status AS status, CASE WHEN o.status = 'CANCELLED' THEN 'Order cancelled' ELSE 'Order accepted' END AS message, i.ticker AS symbol, o.side AS side, CAST(o.quantity AS INTEGER) AS quantity, o.price AS price FROM orders o INNER JOIN instruments i ON i.instrument_id = o.instrument_id WHERE o.order_id = (('x' || substr(md5(#{orderId}), 1, 16))::bit(64)::bigint & 9223372036854775807)
